Name: Bara Anthro Bouncer -PORTRAIT ONLY-
Author: FuwaDoku
Description:
[b]"Totally Necessary Bouncer's Portrait Overhaul – Bara Anthro Edition"[/b]

Are you tired of the portrait for the Bouncer not matching BaraEnthusiast's ultra-mega-giga-sexy anthro mod despite the fact he's not even a real NPC? Do you lose sleep at night knowing that the sprite and portrait clashes in the most heinous way possible? Well, suffer no more! This groundbreaking mod replaces [b]exactly[/b] that portrait to align with said mod, ensuring that your immersion is preserved at [b]all costs[/b].

[b]Features:[/b]

✅ One (1) new portrait that only makes sense if you also have the Bara Anthro mod (It can be applied to both the NSFW and SFW version!).
✅ Absolutely no changes to the sprite, because why would I bother making one when it already exists?
✅ Unwavering dedication to aesthetic consistency (Wow!).
✅ A strong moral stance against the base art that doesn't apply to the designs BaraEnthusiast and Entifrisky gave to the majority of NPCs.

And it's pretty easy to install too! Just download it, extract the .rar file inside your mods folder and done. [b]Experience the game the way it was obviously meant to be played[/b]—as long as you also download the other mods. Otherwise, it just looks weird. But that’s a [i]you[/i] problem.

Aaaand that's all, bye bye!

[size=1][i]MEOW[/i][/size]~
